page.layout: One page of text; margin notes right (small roman numerals I., II., III. beside the paragraphs).

main_text.p: [Excipe Verba quintæ Conjugationis, quæ ω circumflexum Futuri mutant in ῆμαι. ut: στελῶ, στελοῦμαι: σπερῶ, σπερ-οῦμαι.I.
Hoc idem imitantur Attici, in Verbis quartæ Conjugationis, ut: βαδίζω, βαδίῳ, βαδίζομαι.]
Futurum secundum medium, formatur à Futuro secundo activo: ω commutando in οῦμαι. ut: τυπῶ, τυποῦμαι: σαράω, σαρᾶμαι.II.
[Excipe ἐδομαι, πίομαι, φάγομαι: pro ἐ-δῆμαι, πίημαι, φαγῆμαι.]III.
main_text.head: Hactenus formatio Temporum Indicativi medii.
IMPERATIVI medii Perfectum, formatur à Perfecto indicativo: α in ε mutando. ut: τέτυπα, τέτυπε.
main_text.p: Indefinitum primum, ab Indefinito indicativo: ἀμλω in α mutando; & abjiciendo augmentum. ut: ἐτυψάμην, τύψαι: ἐποιησάμην, ποίησαι: ἐδηκάμην, δήκαι.

page.notes: Greek passages are transcribed approximately; the Greek type is worn and several accents are doubtful. The marginal numerals I., II., III. are reconstructed from the scan.
